editorial:
Imagine you are on a boring trip to work with your coworkers when suddenly you see a terrifying vision of a massive bridge falling apart. That is exactly how things start for Sam and his friends. Once they escape the crash, you quickly realize that Death does not like being cheated. The vibe here is all about tension and waiting for the other shoe to drop. You will spend most of the movie staring at everyday objects like gym equipment or kitchen tools, wondering which one is going to cause the next crazy accident. It feels like a deadly game of hide and seek where the seeker always wins.

What really makes this one stand out is the pacing and the creative ways the characters go out. The acting is solid enough for a horror flick, and the twists keep you guessing until the very end. While some of the deaths might feel a bit over the top, that is exactly why you watch these movies. If you love a good thrill, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the details, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: After the survivors think they have cheated death, the story takes a wild turn. You find out that this movie is actually a prequel to the very first film. The main characters end up on a plane to Paris, but as the plane takes off, you see the familiar sight of Flight 180. The survivors realize they were never safe, and the movie ends right as the plane explodes in the air, tying everything back to the start of the series.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves creative horror and unexpected plot twists.
